installation_completion.name: installation_completion

cms_event_scope.name: cms_event_scope
cms_event_scope.value: ("club"."cms_content"."event_id" is null and "club"."cms_content"."module_key" is null) or ("club"."cms_content"."event_id" is not null and "club"."cms_content"."module_key" is not null and "club"."cms_content"."kind" = 'page')

cms_variant_slug_publication.name: cms_variant_slug_publication
cms_variant_slug_publication.value: "club"."cms_variant"."published_slug" is null or "club"."cms_variant"."published_revision_id" is not null

event_creation_receipt.name: event_creation_receipt
event_creation_receipt.value: ("club"."event"."creation_request_id" is null and "club"."event"."creation_review_token" is null) or ("club"."event"."creation_request_id" is not null and "club"."event"."creation_review_token" is not null and "club"."event"."creation_review_token" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

form_webhook_delivery_lease.name: form_webhook_delivery_lease
form_webhook_delivery_lease.value: ("club"."form_webhook_delivery"."status" = 'processing') = ("club"."form_webhook_delivery"."lease_token" is not null and "club"."form_webhook_delivery"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

form_event_kind.name: form_event_kind
form_event_kind.value: ("club"."form"."event_id" is null and "club"."form"."kind" in ('contact', 'membership')) or ("club"."form"."event_id" is not null and "club"."form"."kind" in ('event', 'registration'))

form_notification_lease.name: form_notification_lease
form_notification_lease.value: ("club"."form_notification"."status" = 'processing') = ("club"."form_notification"."lease_token" is not null and "club"."form_notification"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

form_submission_membership.name: form_submission_membership
form_submission_membership.value: "club"."form_submission"."membership_status" is null or ("club"."form_submission"."membership_status" in ('pending', 'approved') and "club"."form_submission"."submitted_by_user_id" is not null)

guest_access_source.name: guest_access_source
guest_access_source.value: ("club"."guest_access"."registration_id" is not null and "club"."guest_access"."registration_user_id" is not null and "club"."guest_access"."luma_guest_id" is null) or ("club"."guest_access"."registration_id" is null and "club"."guest_access"."registration_user_id" is null and "club"."guest_access"."luma_guest_id" is not null)

guest_access_native_identity.name: guest_access_native_identity
guest_access_native_identity.value: "club"."guest_access"."registration_user_id" is null or "club"."guest_access"."claimed_by" is null or "club"."guest_access"."registration_user_id" = "club"."guest_access"."claimed_by"

registration_status.name: registration_status
registration_status.value: ("club"."event_registration"."status" = 'confirmed' and "club"."event_registration"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("club"."event_registration"."status" = 'cancelled' and "club"."event_registration"."cancelled_at" is not null)

registration_authority.name: registration_authority
registration_authority.value: ("club"."registration_settings"."authority" = 'none' and "club"."registration_settings"."form_id" is null and "club"."registration_settings"."open" = false) or ("club"."registration_settings"."authority" = 'native' and "club"."registration_settings"."form_id" is not null) or ("club"."registration_settings"."authority" = 'luma' and "club"."registration_settings"."form_id" is null and "club"."registration_settings"."capacity" is null)

luma_connection_verified.name: luma_connection_verified
luma_connection_verified.value: "club"."luma_connection"."check_state" <> 'verified' or ("club"."luma_connection"."calendar_id" is not null and "club"."luma_connection"."last_success_at" is not null)

luma_link_publication.name: luma_link_publication
luma_link_publication.value: "club"."luma_event_link"."published_at" is null or "club"."luma_event_link"."published_url" is not null

cms_publication_lease.name: cms_publication_lease
cms_publication_lease.value: ("club"."cms_publication_job"."status" = 'processing' and "club"."cms_publication_job"."lease_token" is not null and "club"."cms_publication_job"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("club"."cms_publication_job"."status" <> 'processing' and "club"."cms_publication_job"."lease_token" is null and "club"."cms_publication_job"."lease_expires_at" is null)

luma_job_lease.name: luma_job_lease
luma_job_lease.value: ("club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."status" = 'processing' and "club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."lease_token" is not null and "club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."status" <> 'processing' and "club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."lease_token" is null and "club"."luma_reconciliation_job"."lease_expires_at" is null)

luma_webhook_enabled.name: luma_webhook_enabled
luma_webhook_enabled.value: not "club"."luma_webhook"."enabled" or ("club"."luma_webhook"."secret" is not null and cardinality("club"."luma_webhook"."event_types") > 0)

purchase_refresh_state.name: purchase_refresh_state
purchase_refresh_state.value: ("club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."status" = 'running' and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."finished_at" is null and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."snapshot" is null) or ("club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."status" = 'failed' and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."finished_at" is not null and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."snapshot" is null) or ("club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."status" = 'succeeded' and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."finished_at" is not null and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."snapshot" is not null)

purchase_refresh_failure.name: purchase_refresh_failure
purchase_refresh_failure.value: ("club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."status" = 'failed' and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."failure_code" is not null and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."failure_code" in ('refresh_failed', 'identity_changed')) or ("club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."status" <> 'failed' and "club"."luma_purchase_refresh"."failure_code" is null)
